Personal Data Protection Notice

Last updated: 1 November 2026

1. Controller

Hakan Aydın – AI Trade (sole proprietorship), Cevizli Mah. Zühal Cad. A Ticari Blok Apt. No:46/50, Maltepe/İstanbul, Türkiye · hakan.aydin@aitradeai.net. Data controller under Turkish Personal Data Protection Law No. 6698 (KVKK).

2. What we collect and how

We collect data electronically, through the forms you fill in, your emails and our calls.

  • Check-up form: name, email, company, website, phone (optional), role, monthly order range, sales channel, main concern, timing, your note and, if you choose, figures you entered in the loss estimator.
  • Visitors from our ads: the ad click ID (e.g. Google gclid) and campaign tags (utm_source, utm_campaign).
  • Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad forms: if you fill one in, Meta collects the details and passes them to us.
  • Other contact: what you share when booking through Google Calendar, on WhatsApp or by email.
  • Site visits: our hosting (GitHub Pages) and visit counter (Cloudflare Web Analytics) technically process connection data such as IP address, browser and page visited. The site sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser.

Please do not include your customers' personal data in the forms.

3. Purposes and legal bases

  • Replying to your request, booking the call, preparing the check-up and confirming receipt by email. Legal basis: necessity for entering into a contract (KVKK Art. 5/2-c).
  • Prioritising requests: an automatic priority label is assigned from role, order range and email domain. It only sets the order in which we reply; a person decides on each request. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 5/2-f).
  • Ad measurement: for enquiries that came from an ad, telling the ad platform that the ad led to an enquiry and what the outcome was. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 5/2-f).
  • Site security and visit statistics. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 5/2-f).
  • Legal obligations and disputes. Legal bases: Art. 5/2-ç and 5/2-e.

We do not rely on your explicit consent for this processing.

4. Recipients

  • Our service providers: Google (Workspace: Sheets, Gmail, Apps Script, Calendar), Cloudflare and GitHub. Their servers are outside Türkiye, including in the US, so your data is transferred abroad.
  • Ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta): only for enquiries that came from an ad, the click or lead ID and the status of the enquiry. Your name, email, phone and note are not shared.
  • Public authorities: only where the law requires it.

5. Retention

Enquiries that do not become projects are kept for 12 months after our last contact. If we become your service provider, the statutory retention periods for commercial records apply. Data is then deleted or anonymised.

6. Your rights

Under KVKK Art. 11 you may learn whether we process your data and who receives it, ask for correction or erasure and for recipients to be informed, object to an adverse result produced solely by automated analysis, and claim compensation.

Send a signed letter to the address above, or an email to hakan.aydin@aitradeai.net from the address you gave us (or with a secure or mobile e-signature). Include your name, national ID number (passport number and nationality for foreigners), address, contact details and your request. We reply within 30 days, as a rule free of charge. You may complain to the Turkish Personal Data Protection Board.

7. Emails

Replies and booking emails are service messages. If we ever start a newsletter we will ask separately, and every message will include an opt-out.
